description: This file declares functions related to copy-on-write (COW) storage management within the c10::impl::cow namespace. It provides function prototypes for cloning storage, checking if a storage has a simple DataPtr, verifying if a DataPtr is COW, and materializing COW storage into regular storage.

methods.name: lazy_clone_storage
methods.description: Creates a copy-on-write clone of the provided storage, converting it into a COW storage if it isn't already.

methods.name: has_simple_data_ptr
methods.description: Checks if the provided storage has a simple DataPtr without abnormal context.

methods.name: is_cow_data_ptr
methods.description: Checks if a given DataPtr is a COW DataPtr.

methods.name: materialize_cow_storage
methods.description: Eagerly copies a COW storage's data, converting it into a non-COW storage.
